source: Static Thumb-2 disassembly (capstone 5) of the bundled STM32 main-controller HEX images; see docs/re/firmware.md
table_format: 16-byte entries {opcode:u16le, frame_length:u16le, any_length:u8, f5:u8, f6:u8, pad:u8, handler:u32, continuation:u32}, terminated by opcode 0xffff. Lookup by frame parser (Link 3 0x08065920). any_length=0 means the request frame length must equal frame_length exactly; 1 means any length. f6=1 marks transfer commands that (re)arm the upload watchdog on success (Link 3 0x0806623e). f5 is copied to ctx+0x21 (meaning unknown). continuation is called on later dispatcher passes for long-running commands (Link 3 0x08065e86).

status_legend.recovered: read directly from the table/handler code

image_info.value: 600x800, picture_types 0x02, options 0x7b, max_bytes 153600, 23-byte frame with option2=0

print_block_size.evidence: 0x08080dfa / 0x08080e02 (same value for SPP and BLE); table frame_length 911 for 1001

start_checks.value: type must be 2; option1 0x80 rejected, option1&7 must be <4, 0x08/0x10/0x20/0x40 allowed; option2 must be 0; byte3 read into a scratch byte (0x20021954) and ignored; 1<=length<=153600; transfer state must be idle/started/data else 0x82

upload_watchdog.value: reloaded by every successful 1000/1001; SPP 4925 ticks, BLE 5910 ticks (about 49 s / 59 s at 10 ms); on expiry the upload state is dropped and later 1001/1002 return 0x85 TIMEOUT; no disconnect
upload_watchdog.evidence: cfg 0x080f7ee4 (+6 SPP, +8 BLE), arm 0x08066244, tick 0x08065f4a (T10MS task 0x080960e4), 0x85 at 0x08080f78

conn_params_0103.value: 4 x u16 BE; 0x81 unless 6<=min<=3200, 6<=max<=3200, max>=min, latency<500, 10<=timeout<=3200; no (1+latency)*interval*2<timeout rule; result 0 is sent before the radio applies it; forwarded to the BT module only while a BLE link is up (BT message / UART command 0xba, 8 bytes), ignored when only SPP is connected
conn_params_0103.evidence: handler 0x08096478, check 0x08096518, forward 0x08069d5e -> BT state handler 0x0806a250 (states 2/4) vs no-op 0x0806a242 (states 1/3)

auto_sleep_0102.value: modes 0..5 (>=6 -> 0x81): 0 read saved, 1 read session, 2 read factory (3000 x4), 3 extend (restart timer only), 4 set session + restart, 5 set + save to NV + restart; modes 4/5 require each timer 0 (off) or >=1500; units about 0.1 s (value*985/1000, counted in 100 ms steps)
auto_sleep_0102.evidence: handler 0x08080af8, check 0x08080ca0, apply 0x08060214, timeout pick 0x08061f16, countdown 0x080613d0, factory 0x080f82d0

ble_name.value: 'INSTAX-' + '7' + 7-char serial + '(BLE)'; Classic name the same with '(EDR)'
ble_name.evidence: builders 0x08059d10 (LE) / 0x08059c44 (EDR), templates 0x080f8360 / 0x080f8350, model char 0x08059f30, 20-byte serial record read from NV 0x2000 at 0x08057dfa into 0x2001d8e4 (chars at +6), fallback '0000000' from 0x080f8188 at 0x0805868a

adv_data.value: flags 0x05, 128-bit service 70954782-..., TX power 6 dBm, manufacturer 0x04d8 data 07 00; alternative set with service data UUID 0xFE2C, model e49b83 (Fast Pair layout)

bt_architecture.value: external Realtek RTL8753BFR over UART; the MCU sees only connect/disconnect/data/parameter-update events; no MCU-side pairing, bonding or encryption check
bt_architecture.evidence: event switch 0x0806cc22, BT state table 0x08020980, UART command encoder 0x0806dcb4

silent_drop.value: after a 0x90 LOW_POWER / 0x91 result, flag 0x2001e054+0x20 makes every later command go unanswered (internal code 0x13) (Link 3 0x080661f2, 0x08065dd4)
